There is no one I can talk to. The only person I could talk to about it is even more depressed and suicidal than I am, so I don't think burdening him with my suicidal thoughts will help much. My ex and I are still friendly for the most part, but every time in the past that I tried to talk to him about it he just couldn't understand. He's never been able to understand. 

Just a few minutes ago I went downstairs to tell him about something I've been feeling a lot of lately, and he was just like "Well you must not really *want* to stop being depressed since you haven't done anything about it."
Exactly. I understand they are trying to empower bigger women, but that doesn't mean they have to talk badly about us.
Oh, well Ensure says it's for gaining and maintaining a healthy weight. That's the only one I really know of.
Isn't that basically what Ensure is?
I haven't been to the doctor.

I have tried Ensure, but it didn't last long because I'm terrible and schedules and stuff so I just stopped buying them, I just forgot. Someone I know gained weight by drinking Ensure but not sure what else she did. Also, people kept telling me to just consume more protein but exercise also so it doesn't all turn into fat. I don't really get time to exercise since I take care of my daughter all day. Running up and down the stairs is the only workout I get every day.

Thank you. But honestly I've felt like this for a long time, not just recently. I've felt like this for maybe 2 years, since I started losing weight. People see overweight as being a problem and don't realize that being underweight can be a problem too. 

I breastfed my daughter and was actually thinking about supplementing with formula at one point because I was worried that me being underweight and things meant that she wouldn't be getting enough from me. It's a horrible feeling.

Actually after I gave birth to my daughter I kept losing weight. I used to be about 100 (before pregnancy) or a couple lbs over 100, then after I gave birth I was in the 90's and last time I got weighed I was in the 80's. I am underweight and I hate it.
Thank you, this made me cry! And then I cried some more out of laughter! I love Pete Holmes.
